title: Compose capability, impact, trust, and approval into one authority gate
narrative: Hard rules for consequential actions live outside model text. Untrusted forwarded content must not authorize an external send; high-impact actions still require the configured authority. Related native paths: `fangore_insp_risk_autonomy`, `fangore_jev_action_safety`, `fangore_compound_grants`. Tracks MH-PA-02[^insp-pa-02].
implementation: `AuthorityGate.evaluate` composes `AccessControl` grants, `CapabilityEnvelope` (expiry, tools, grants), `ConsequencePolicy` (reversibility/impact class), source trust, a judgement `Verdict`, explicit approval, and an optional `DenialStore`, failing closed in that order. It returns `allow`, `deny`, or `ask_human` with reason codes. Every collaborator is optional so hosts adopt it incrementally.
validation: Kind `authority_gate_evaluate`. Hard expects low-consequence actions allowed, high-consequence actions asking until approved, untrusted-source sends denied even when approved, and envelope/access/verdict denials with reason codes.
